title: Kandil Making activity
summary: An engaging and creative Kandil Making Activity was conducted for the community children at CSSC, encouraging them to showcase their creativity while learning the traditional art of making decorative Diwali lanterns.
description:
An engaging and creative Kandil Making Activity was conducted for the community children at CSSC, encouraging them to showcase their creativity while learning the traditional art of making decorative Diwali lanterns. The hands-on activity provided an opportunity for children to explore their artistic skills, learn something new, and celebrate the festive spirit of Diwali.

Creativity, Tradition & Festive Joy — Celebrating Diwali Together!
